vcal.title: Calendar
vcal.error: Your calendar couldn't be loaded right now.
vcal.busyHint: Entry from another role – only the time is shown
vcal.doneError: That couldn't be saved right now.
vcal.progressAllDone: All done – enjoy the rest of your day ✨

empty.title: Nothing planned – a calm day 🌿
empty.hint: Tell Vitana what you have in mind and she'll add it.

work.readOnly: You finish this where it lives – the calendar only shows when it is due.

subscribe.title: Show in my calendar app
subscribe.intro: Subscribe to your Vitanaland calendar in Apple, Google or Outlook. New entries show up there on their own.
subscribe.privacy: The link shows only titles, times and places – no details. Anyone with the link can see these entries, so keep it to yourself.
subscribe.replaceHint: A new link replaces the old one – the old one stops working.
subscribe.onlyOnce: You only see this link now. Copy it or open it straight in your calendar app.
subscribe.copyError: Copying didn't work – select the link and copy it yourself.
subscribe.activeSince: A link has been active since {date}.
subscribe.error: That didn't work just now. Please try again in a moment.

move.title: New time
move.error: That couldn't be moved just now. Try again in a moment.

blocked.owned_by_source: This comes from a booking or a plan – move it there, or it will jump back.
blocked.recurring: Move a series from the series itself.
blocked.completed: Done entries stay where they were.

google.title: Sync with Google Calendar
google.intro: Your Vitanaland entries go to their own "Vitanaland" calendar in your Google account. Your Google events show here as grey busy times – no titles.
google.problem: The last sync didn't work – we'll retry automatically.
google.error: That didn't work just now. Try again in a moment.
google.busyHint: An event from your Google calendar – only the time is visible

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.body: No reminders arrive during your quiet hours – they come just before.
